summary: Official national Uzbek cadastral portal and ArcGIS service host were identified, but anonymous portal and REST requests timed out. No parcel geometry or schema was retained.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Uzbek discovery queries are recorded in city-4000-qoqand.json.

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official public portal did not respond within 30 seconds via direct anonymous GET. No login, CAPTCHA, token or bypass attempted.
Published ArcGIS REST service directory did not respond within 20 seconds over HTTPS. TLS verification remained enabled.
HTTP fallback also timed out within 15 seconds; no TLS downgrade was used to obtain data and no schema or geometry was obtained.
Search-indexed catalog material identifies this as the ArcGIS REST services endpoint for the official national portal; this is route evidence, not a successful service response.
Official Digital Government page describes the National Geoinformation Portal as providing open State Register of Rights to Real Estate data and cadastral-number, location and land-use information.
Official Uzbek-language page confirms the same national portal and cadastral open-data scope.
Official Kadastr Agency site identifies the agency and its cadastral/open-data activities; no Qoqand parcel endpoint was exposed in the retrieved result.

requestCoordinates.coordinateOrderNote: WUP point preserved as latitude/longitude. No exact-point query completed; no coordinate shift applied.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if exposed
geometryQuality: No parcel geometry response obtained; zero samples retained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not completed because the official portal and REST service timed out; this is not evidence of parcel absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Uzbekistan national cadastral/geoinformation infrastructure operated by the Kadastr Agency.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official portal, agency, and service-route evidence only; anonymous parcel schema, CRS, stable identity, geometry, and Qoqand/countrywide coverage unverified.

scopeLimits: Zero exact-point hits, map extent miss, service failure, timeout, or unusable UI do not establish citywide parcel absence.
National custodian evidence does not prove a Qoqand-local registry endpoint or complete city coverage.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, personal or unsafe fields were requested, logged or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not admit a runtime adapter.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review remains required
uncertainty: A current interactive endpoint may require browser-delivered configuration, different routing, or access unavailable to anonymous direct requests. Parcel completeness, legal status, update currency, stable identity and CRS remain unverified.
